summary.text: Caryn Tyson is a Republican who represents Kansas Senate District 12 in Linn County and has served in the Senate since 2013, after serving in the Kansas House in 2011 and 2012.
She is the Senate Assistant Majority Leader and chairs the Assessment and Taxation Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to her Kansas Legislature profile, Tyson is a software engineer, and her spouse is Tim Tyson.
She chairs the 2025 Special Committee on Taxation.

She is also a member of the Commerce, Federal and State Affairs, Organization, Calendar and Rules, and Transportation committees, the Joint Committee on Administrative Rules and Regulations, and the Legislative Post Audit Committee.
